purpose: Form INC-28 is used for filing the certified copy of the order of the Regional Director approving the alteration of memorandum for transfer of registered office within the same State from the jurisdiction of one Registrar of Companies to another, or for filing a copy of the order made by the Tribunal by the liquidator.
who: Not stated in the Rules text
when: Within thirty days from the date of receipt of the certified copy of the order
steps: Receive the certified copy of the order of the Regional Director approving the alteration of memorandum for transfer of registered office within the same State, or receive the order made by the Tribunal.
File Form INC-28 with the Registrar of State along with the required fee within the specified time limit.
checklist: Certified copy of the order of the Regional Director approving the alteration of memorandum for transfer of registered office within the same State, or copy of the order made by the Tribunal
Prescribed fee for filing Form INC-28
watch: Ensure the form is filed within thirty days from the date of receipt of the certified copy of the order.
